class.name: NNCustomPropertyConsideration
class.brief_description: Scores a behaviour from a numeric property of any node.

method.name: sample_activation_curve
method.description: Returns the y-value of the activation curve at [param input_value], or [code]0.0[/code] when no curve is set.

members.member: The node whose [member property_name] property is read. The consideration scores [code]0.0[/code] when this is not set.
The value [member property_name] is divided by to normalise it to the [code]0..1[/code] range before the activation curve is sampled. Must be finite and non-zero.
The name of the numeric property read from [member node_with_property].
